system.description: You peel a thin layer of wax from the face of a sleeping or dead person. Whatever the result, roll a d2 when you take the mask off: on a 1, you forget one of your own core memories.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and you also gain their voice.
outcomes.success: When you wear the wax mask, you become that person for 24 hours. You gain their appearance, scent and fingerprints.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the wax crumbles.
outcomes.ruin: You become them, and cannot take the mask off until your next Downtime. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
